text:
Ravi Singh: quick flag 50% of MedFin pilot NER samples show drug-name aliasing after we merged the LoRA. fp16 was clean. anyone seen token-splitting like this on int4?
Lena Ortiz: saw similar behavior in a different customer last quarter. usually tokenization + quant noise amplifies low-prob tokens.
Marta Kovac: which quant pipeline did you use? naive per-tensor symmetric?
Ravi Singh: yes, default int4-per-tensor from onboarding-script v2.2. link: <https://redwood-internal/docs/onboard-int4>
Lena Ortiz: can you paste a failing example?
Ravi Singh: example:
expected: "ibuprofen"
produced alias: "ibu-profen" (model returned short-hand token not in vocab)
Also tokenizer shows split into ["ibu","profen"].
ci-bot: CI eval pack started: medfin-quick-eval 56 cases.
Marta Kovac: two quick experiments: 1) try per-channel scales, 2) increase calibration to 2048 with stratified sampling of rare tokens. Per-channel usually preserves dynamic range for important outliers.
Lena Ortiz: add a tiny LoRA alpha reduction (0.12 -> 0.09) too; reduces additive tail mass that quantization can blow up.
Ravi Singh: running per-channel + calib=2048 now on rwd-p4d-03. ETA ~30m. command:
```
./run_quick_eval --model medfin-lora-v1 --quant int4-per-channel --calib 2048 --evalset medfin_ner
```
infra-bot: Job rwd-qc-332999 started on rwd-p4d-03.
(eval silence ~35m)
ci-bot: quick-eval done. Results: fp16 F1=0.894, int4-per-tensor F1=0.855, int4-per-channel+calib2048 F1=0.886, halluc_rate int4-per-channel=1.1% vs fp16=0.7%. Full artifacts: <https://redwood-internal/evals/3329998888/artifacts.zip>
Marta Kovac: per-channel + bigger calib recovered most of the delta. still small gap. next step: try GPTQ outlier-clamp and smaller LoRA alpha.
Lena Ortiz: if that closes gap, we should create a MedFin-specific quant profile and add a runbook note: "Prefer per-channel int4 for medical entity finetunes; calibrate on rare-token stratified samples."
Ravi Singh: agree. I'll run alpha tweak overnight and open a PR with eval artifacts. tagging @Marta to review quant options.
Marta Kovac: will add a short checklist for onboarding med finetunes: tokenization sanity, quant-profile trylist, calib-size, LoRA alpha bounds, smoke examples to verify.
Ravi Singh: thanks team. we'll hold this canary on Dedicated until PR lands.
